handoffs.message: Auto-reassigned MGMT-OPS-004 away from unavailable lane Antigravity2 (disabled, paused, sidecar-only, or auth-down); owner Antigravity2 -> Codex.
PR #3068 merged; verified with local unit tests (FastAPI/pytest: 11 tests passed; vitest: 7 tests passed) and successful production build.

Reviewer (Claude): reopening for a correctness bug. ManagementPerformanceReviewPanel.tsx:1011 renders the fallback attribution row's persona label as readModel?.identity.persona_label || "Crypto-Alt-Hunter" — a hardcoded literal copied from the persona-20260528-04688755 test fixture. operations_read_model.py:60/142 confirms persona_label is Optional and is None whenever no persona_fleet_summary row supplies a label, so any OTHER persona that hits fallback/degraded confidence without a fleet-summary label will incorrectly display the unrelated name 'Crypto-Alt-Hunter' in both the Focus Persona metadata panel context and the Fallback Summary Rows table. This directly contradicts the task's goal of a trustworthy, non-misleading drilldown. Required change: replace the hardcoded fallback with a generic placeholder (e.g. focus.personaId or 'Persona label unavailable'), and add a regression assertion that the fallback row never renders a different persona's name when persona_label is null. Rest of the drilldown (confidence banner, metadata panel, source coverage, diagnostics cards) reviewed and looks correct against acceptance criteria.

Replaced the hardcoded 'Crypto-Alt-Hunter' fallback label with a generic 'Persona label unavailable' placeholder, and added a regression test asserting that it is never rendered when persona_label is null. The changes have been compiled, verified with tests, committed, and merged via PR #3070.

Reviewed PR #3068/#3070: attribution view model, confidence banner, split formal/fallback sections, source coverage, and actionable missing-holdings diagnostics meet MGMT-OPS-004 acceptance. Verified frontend: npx vitest run ManagementPerformanceReviewPanel.test.tsx (8/8 pass). Backend: pytest test_bff_mgmt_ops_001_operations_read_model_contract.py (11/11 pass). npm run build:management succeeds. Fallback persona label no longer hardcodes 'Crypto-Alt-Hunter'; regression test confirms. Approved and returned to owner Antigravity for finalization.
